summary: Tested the Dropbox OAuth fix (iteration 3). Backend: 9/9 pass (7 new tests plus 2 kept from iteration 2). The start URL has token_access_type=offline, response_type=code, the correct redirect_uri and a state value, with no scope param. The start endpoint needs auth. Admin status returns configured=true, connected=false, missing_scopes=[]. The callback with error=access_denied, with code=x&state=bogus, and with no params all return 307 to /admin?dropbox=error&reason=..., and the bogus-state case gives reason=Invalid%20or%20expired%20OAuth%20state. UI: admin login works. /admin?dropbox=error&reason=Test%20reason shows the error toast 'Dropbox connection failed: Test reason.' and the URL is cleared to /admin. Clicking Connect Dropbox goes to www.dropbox.com/oauth2/authorize (no scope param), and Dropbox shows the page 'Log in or sign up to Dropbox to link with Cooked World' with no authorize_error, so Dropbox accepts the request. I did not sign in to Dropbox. The home page renders.

ui_bugs.issue: 2 sonner toasts were found after one visit to /admin?dropbox=error. Likely cause: React.StrictMode runs the useEffect twice in dev before setParams clears the query. Cosmetic, and probably only in dev.

action_items: Optional: pass an id to the toasts in AdminPanel (e.g. toast.error(msg, {id: 'dbx-oauth'})) so the StrictMode double effect does not show two toasts

The user still has to finish the real Dropbox sign-in to confirm the token exchange and that the granted scope string is stored. If Dropbox's token response leaves out 'scope', missing_scopes will stay [] because status() only checks when scopes are stored (fail-open).
critical_code_review_comments: dropbox_svc.status: missing_scopes is only worked out when row.scopes is non-empty. If the token response has no 'scope' field, missing permissions are hidden silently. Consider checking capabilities with a test call (e.g. files_list_folder('')) after the token exchange.
AdminGate: if the session has expired when Dropbox redirects back, /admin?dropbox=... goes to /admin/login and the query (with the error reason) is lost.
seed_data_creation: None. The only data created was short-lived oauth_states entries from calling the start endpoint.
test_credentials: Admin allisgoodworld@yahoo.com / CookedWorld#2026 (1 API login + 1 UI login, no failures)
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Dropbox authorize page now loads (redirect URI registered, no scope param). The next step, the real token exchange, needs a human Dropbox sign-in. The preview may show 'Booting up the preview' on first load, so wait and reload.
